results.postgres_sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', event_time) d, count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_events WHERE event_time > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
results.clickhouse_sql: SELECT toDate(event_time) d, uniqExact(user_id) FROM %[1]s.user_events%[2]s WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

results.query: events per kind per week, 6 months
results.postgres_sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', event_time) w, kind, count(*) FROM user_events GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
results.clickhouse_sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(event_time) w, kind, count() FROM %[1]s.user_events%[2]s WHERE _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY w, kind ORDER BY w, kind

results.query: top 10 accounts by events, last 7 days
results.postgres_sql: SELECT account_id, count(*) c FROM user_events WHERE event_time > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
results.clickhouse_sql: SELECT account_id, count() c FROM %[1]s.user_events%[2]s WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10

results.query: p95 latency per endpoint, last 30 days
results.postgres_sql: SELECT path, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) FROM request_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
results.clickhouse_sql: SELECT path, quantileExact(0.95)(duration_ms) FROM %[1]s.request_logs%[2]s WHERE created_at > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY path ORDER BY path

duckdb_memory_limit: 2GB (agent user memory is capped on this shared box)
